entities.name: Redtooth
entities.description: A vigilant, cautious wolf of Arlinn Kord's pack on Innistrad.

entities.name: Arlinn Kord
entities.description: A planeswalker and the alpha of the wolf pack.

entities.name: Streak
entities.description: A pack wolf and Redtooth's mate.

entities.name: Katilda
entities.description: A witch who appeared as an enigmatic stag.

entities.name: Tovolar
entities.description: An influential figure in Arlinn's past whom the pack aligned with.

entities.name: Thraben Cathedral
entities.description: The cathedral where Arlinn was gravely injured.

events.summary: The pack met an enigmatic stag who was the witch Katilda, and Redtooth snarled and stayed on guard.
events.quote: Redtooth snarled and remained on guard

events.summary: The pack met Tovolar and aligned with him, leaving Arlinn alone.
events.quote: Redtooth and the pack aligned with Tovolar

events.summary: When Arlinn was gravely injured in Thraben Cathedral, the pack returned to her side.
events.quote: when Arlinn was gravely injured in Thraben Cathedral , the pack returned to her side

relations.note: The pack showed loyalty to Tovolar's cause.
relations.quote: continued to show loyalty to Tovolar's cause
